title: Wolverine Legend Hugh Jackman Looks Set to Invest in an English Football Team, Following Deadpool Star Ryan Reynolds' Success With Wrexham
snippet: Hugh Jackman's Wolverine looks set to follow Ryan Reynolds' Deadpool in co-owning an English football team.

title: Marvel Secretly Developing New Live-Action Disney+ Project, Potentially Young Avengers or New Mutants
snippet: A flurry of reports point to Marvel secretly mounting a new live-action Disney+ series, potentially featuring characters from the Young Avengers or New Mutants.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves Directors Say Film Flopped Due to 'Not-So-Great' Timing
snippet: The directors of Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves, John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein, admitted the fantasy flick flopped due to “not-so-great timing” because of The Super Mario Bros. movie and drama with Wizards of the Coast’s proposed D&D licensing changes.

title: Waffle House Movie in the Works Starring X-Men’s Inde Navarrette
snippet: Not content just to appear in Marvel's X-Men reboot, Inde Navarrette has signed on to star in a bizarre sci-fi thriller called The Waffle House Index.

title: China hits back at G20 statement on its reliance on exports, accusing them of 'promoting protectionism'
snippet: China rejected G20 pressure over export-driven growth while also challenging U.S. Iran sanctions and European trade measures.

title: New York Fed's Williams says yield surge due to strong economic prospects

title: Berkshire CEO Greg Abel says Japanese bond yields not a challenge for trading houses right now
snippet: In an appearance on CNBC's "Squawk Box," Greg Abel said that yields in the country are still relatively low.

title: Nepal’s mountain tourism industry faces ‘serious warning’ after Himalayan flood disaster

title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it

title: Prediction market traders think job creation rebounded in August

title: Crypto exchange Gemini not at fault for collapse of Earn lending program, arbitrator says
